en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Musa Bin Bakr, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> the 1st having said:
‘But rather the Assistance upon a people is upon a measurement of their needs, and that the guest lodges with a people so his sustenance descends with him in his lap’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Musa ibn Bukayr who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, al-Awwal, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Help descends on a people proportionate to their needs. A guest comes to a people but he comes with his sustenance in his lap.’”
